role: Development-only two-strategy pre-trade allocator that arbitrates the mature Directional strategy-wide named-contract request vector and one atomic Calendar Spread pair against one Formal Account's market and initial-margin constraints.
invariants: fixed development entitlement is 50 percent Directional and 50 percent Calendar Spread
the allocator consumes risk-approved strategy requests and cannot create strategy alpha or expand either request
Directional ordinary allocation follows one deterministic proportional path across its whole named-contract request vector
Calendar Spread ordinary allocation remains an atomic plus-one/minus-one Main/Adjacent-Next pair
mandatory strategy-risk reductions are evaluated before ordinary risk-increasing flow
exchange hard limits still bind mandatory reductions and blocked mandatory reduction requires portfolio-risk escalation
single-contract position limits are checked on aggregate Formal Account named-contract positions
turn limits are checked on external net market orders after internal-cross preview
all-contract gross position cap is checked on aggregate Formal Account positions
initial margin is checked once on aggregate Formal Account named-contract positions using the Formal Account margin rate
internal netting changes external market footprint but never deletes strategy ownership
internal cross transfer price and fills are not owned by this allocator
unused entitlement may reallocate when one strategy is blocked by an additional constraint
strategy function call order is not an allocation input
no Strategy Book, Formal Account, cash, margin or market state is mutated
